printer_notes: Experimental Rinkhals beta, single-material only. Requires a saved bed mesh named default and a PAUSE macro. Load and prime the filament manually before printing. Verify homing, mesh, fan controls and Z-offset on your firmware. No automatic print-start retries. Not for stock firmware or KX-Bridge.
